podcast.title: Fill-in Performance for U2 (1993)
podcast.body: Edward Morgan successfully filled in for Adam Clayton on bass during a U2 concert at the Sydney Football Stadium on November 26, 1993. This performance marked the only time U2 has performed with a substitute member. "Now that first show went off just fine."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Bass Tech for Adam Clayton
podcast.body: Edward Morgan served as the bass tech for U2's Adam Clayton. In an emergency on November 26, 1993, during the Zoo TV tour in Sydney, Morgan stepped in to play bass for U2 when Clayton was too drunk to perform. "He was up to a Rody Adam's base text to Edward Morgan to fill in."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

xref.title: Inability to Perform in Sydney (1993)
xref.body: On November 26, 1993, Adam Clayton was scheduled to play the first of two nights at Sydney Football Stadium, a show intended as a rehearsal for a globally broadcast event. However, he was too intoxicated to take the stage, necessitating his bass tech, Edward Morgan, to fill in for him. "But Adam was way too drunk to be on stage."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
